The library for new students – The Library – Høgskolen i Østfold
The library for new students
Welcome to the library at Østfold University of Applied Sciences! We are here to support you actively during your studies. In Halden you will find us on the ground floor and in Fredrikstad you will find us in the H building.

Opening hours
Monday-Thursday: 08:00-19:00
Friday: 08:00-18:00
Changed opening hours will be announced.
After 15:00 the library is staffed by student assistants. If you need assistance from a librarian, please contact us before this time.
How to borrow?
Use your student card or student ID app at our self-checkout machine to borrow and return books. You can return books at both campus libraries and in our return boxes outside the library.
The loan period is 4 weeks for books and 2 weeks for textbooks. If no one is on the waiting list, the book will be automatically renewed.
